file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for Brunel University of London Medicine MBBS A100. Executable rules live in data/universities/brunel-university-of-london-a100.json and data/interview-band-configs/brunel-university-of-london-a100.json.

research_scope.evidence_intake_basis: /Users/faizan/Desktop/medical university research/University-data-list/Brunel/brunel.docx and pasted approved implementation interpretation supplied on 2026-07-20
research_scope.notes: The previous repository file was an MSC seed. This implementation follows the approved interpretation that Home selection is ucat_ranking after academic and SJT gates, not a blended academic/UCAT score.

evidence_classification_policy.official_policy: A rule attributed in the supplied research to Brunel official admissions material.
evidence_classification_policy.foi_historical_guidance: Cycle-labelled historical UCAT observations in the embedded FOI image table, used only for interview-stage guidance.
evidence_classification_policy.applysmart_derived_guidance: Derived public guidance bands calibrated from historical observations and clearly not official future thresholds.
evidence_classification_policy.reference_only: Data preserved for transparency but not used by ApplySmart interview prediction.
evidence_classification_policy.manual_review: Evidence exists but cannot be executed safely without route-specific confirmation.
evidence_classification_policy.unsupported: The supplied evidence does not establish a deterministic rule.

science_practical_endorsement.reason: Requirement not verified in supplied evidence.

metadata.gcse_mathematics_discrepancy: Source text shows grade 5/B. Runtime enforces numeric Grade 5 and records the B wording as an unresolved discrepancy.
metadata.repository_discrepancy_reported_before_e: Existing Brunel A100 production JSON was a low-confidence MSC seed with unknown eligibility and selection rules.

route_limited_blockers: International applicants follow a separate non-UCAT route with no executable numerical formula.
Graduate A100 route has contradictory UCAT/GAMSAT evidence.
Scottish, Access to HE and BTEC routes were not verified.
Science practical endorsement requirement was not verified.
GCSE Mathematics source wording mixes numeric Grade 5 and legacy B.

steps: Reject Home applicants with SJT Band 4.
Rank eligible Home applicants by total UCAT score.
Use historical Home interview-stage UCAT observations for non-guaranteed competitiveness guidance.
Return insufficient evidence for International applicants rather than applying Home UCAT guidance.

offer_stage_reference_only.reason: ApplySmart predicts interview competitiveness only. Offer-stage UCAT figures are retained as reference evidence and are not used as interview thresholds.

contextual.notes: Contextual information is downstream offer metadata only.
